title: Repair the caption
prompt: `Entry` and its record types are supplied. `Caption` should return `"Soup (15 min)"` for a `Ready` entry, `"Soup (no estimate)"` for a `Ready` entry with 0 minutes, `"Salad blocked: no lettuce"` for a `Blocked` entry, and only the title for any other entry. The starter does not compile, and it is missing one case. Read the compiler error, then repair the method.
hints: The error names an arm that can never run. Which arm above it already matches everything?
Move the _ arm to the bottom. Then decide where a Ready entry with 0 minutes must be handled.
Put Ready { Minutes: 0 } r above Ready r, and keep _ => entry.Title as the last arm.
checks: Practice.Caption(new Blocked("Salad", "no lettuce")) == "Salad blocked: no lettuce"
checkLabels: A Ready entry must show its title and minutes, as in "Soup (15 min)".
A Ready entry with 0 minutes must show "(no estimate)" after its title.
A Blocked entry must show its title, then " blocked: ", then its reason.
A Blocked entry with an empty reason must still end with " blocked: ".
Any other entry must return only its title.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Fixes the arm order but never handles 0 minutes.
Deletes the discard arm to silence the error, so other entries match nothing.
Puts the 0-minute arm below the general Ready arm.

feedback: Read your arms from the top for the failing entry. A specific arm must sit above the general arm that also matches it, and the _ arm must stay last.
